Exactly, it’s a mixed bag. The note was a small reminder that not everyone sees me the same way my supervisor does.
It's good to hold onto that perspective. You do valuable work. Sometimes it’s just hard to remember that amid criticism.
True. I've been trying to focus on my painting to destress but even that has become a bit overwhelming.
Taking up painting sounds like a great creative outlet. What’s making it overwhelming?
I think I put too much pressure on myself to excel at it, instead of just enjoying the process.
It's understandable to want to do well in something new. Maybe allowing yourself to just enjoy the activity would make it more relaxing.
I guess I just need to remind myself to let go of perfectionism. It's tough sometimes.
It really is. It might help to remember that hobbies are meant to bring joy and relaxation, not stress.
That’s true. I’ll try to keep that in mind the next time I pick up the brush.
That sounds like a good plan. It’s important to be kind to yourself during this journey.
Thanks for reminding me of that. I needed to hear it.
Anytime, Amanda. You're doing your best, and that's enough.
Hey, are you available to talk for a bit?
Of course, Amanda. What's on your mind?
Well, I got some unexpected news at work today.
Oh? What happened?
My supervisor offered me a promotion.
Wow, that's big news! How are you feeling about it?
Honestly, I'm feeling pretty anxious about it.
I can imagine. A promotion brings a lot of changes. What part is making you the most anxious?
I think it's the increased responsibilities. I'm already feeling stretched at work with everything that's been going on.
With your supervisor constantly undermining you, I can see why this would add stress. Have they addressed your past concerns?
Not really. The negative performance review still hangs over me. The promotion feels like they're trying to make up for that.
That must be quite confusing for you. Do you feel like this promotion is genuine recognition of your work?
I'm not sure. Part of me wonders if it's just to keep me from looking elsewhere. With everything with Bill and John Doe, I've just been on edge.
It sounds like a lot to juggle. Do you have anyone at work you trust to discuss this with, like Sarah who sent you that note?
Sarah's been supportive, but I don't want to burden her. I'm also worried about being too vulnerable at work.
It's understandable to feel wary. What helps you ground yourself when things feel unstable?
I've been painting, but recently it's added to my stress. I keep pushing myself to be perfect in it too.
Perfectionism can be tough. How about leaning into the joy of painting instead of the pressure to excel?
I should try that. I sometimes forget it doesn't have to be another thing I master right away.
Exactly. It's okay to allow yourself some space to enjoy without expectations. What do you think about the promotion now?
I'm still scared, but I think I need to have an open talk with my supervisor about what support looks like moving forward.
That sounds like a great step. Being clear about your needs can help manage this transition.
Thank you for listening. I needed to get this off my chest before making a decision.
Anytime, Amanda. You're navigating a lot, and you're doing it with so much grace.
Thanks for saying that. I'll let you know how it goes.
I'm here anytime. Take care, Amanda.
Hey, are you there? I could use someone to talk to.
I'm here, Amanda. What's on your mind?
I just found out a family member is really sick, and it's been weighing on me heavily.
I'm so sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what happened, or how you're feeling about it?
It's just... I feel like everything is piling up lately. Work stress, personal life... now this.
It sounds incredibly overwhelming. It makes sense to feel burdened by all of this.
Exactly. I thought I'd finally caught a break when things started looking up with my coworker and getting a promotion offer.
And now, with that added pressure, having a sick family member must make it even harder to balance everything.
Yes, and I haven't really processed any of it. I'm just constantly on edge. My ex-boyfriend stuff doesn't help either.
Oh, I remember you mentioning unresolved feelings with your ex. How have those been affecting you lately?
Valentine's Day opened that can of worms again. Everything seemed to come at once and continues to be a mess.
That sounds tough, Amanda. Managing your feelings about your ex on top of work stress and family concerns can be draining.
Exactly, and when I argue with my best friend, it feels like I have nowhere to turn.
It must be lonely and frustrating feeling like your support system is compromised.
It is. I'm trying to keep it together, stay strong for everyone, but I feel like I'm the one falling apart.
Remember, it's okay to take moments for yourself. You're carrying a lot, and it's okay to not be okay.
Thanks for saying that. I don't know, I just wish things were simpler.
It's normal to wish for simpler times. Small steps, like focusing on one task at a time, might help lessen the load.
Yeah, maybe I need to start with that. Taking things one day at a time.
That's a good starting point. And remember, leaning on others, like you're doing now, is a strength, not a weakness.
Thank you. I really appreciate you being here and listening.
Anytime, Amanda. Don't hesitate to reach out whenever you need to talk, okay?
I will. Thanks for being such a great friend.
You're welcome. Take care of yourself, and remember, you're not alone in this.
Hey, do you have a moment to chat?
Absolutely, Amanda! What's on your mind?
It's about Bill. He reached out to me recently, and it's bringing up a lot of old feelings.
I can imagine how complex that must feel, especially after everything you've gone through. How has that been affecting you?
Honestly, it's confusing. Part of me is curious and maybe even hopeful, but another part of me is scared and unsure.
That makes a lot of sense. It's normal to have mixed emotions in situations like these. Have you thought about what you really want out of this interaction with him?
That's the hard part. I don't know if I'm ready to open that chapter again, especially after the breakup. It took a lot to get through that.
Breaking up was a significant step, given your past disagreements on future plans. How did you handle it back then, and could those insights help you now?
I had to focus on myself and my career. I spent time understanding what I need from a partner, and that really helped me. But hearing from Bill now is just... it's like everything's in the air again.
It's clear you've done a lot of personal work since then. How have your priorities or needs shifted over the past months, especially with your promotion and current stresses?
I guess I've been more focused on my career and managing my stress. The promotion is exciting yet overwhelming. I think I need stability more than anything else right now.
Stability is crucial, especially when you're dealing with so much change. Do you think rekindling things with Bill aligns with that need for stability?
That's where I'm stuck. If it’s anything like before, it might not help. But I can't deny there's a part of me that misses him and wonders if things could be different.
It's understandable to miss someone you shared so much history with. What do you think would be different if you two were to try again?
If anything's different, it has to be our communication. We need to be on the same page about our goals, and that's what makes me hesitant. I'm afraid I'll get hurt again.
It sounds like you value clear communication and aligned goals, which are definitely important. Do you feel comfortable discussing these concerns with him openly?
I think I could, but I'm also afraid of what I might hear. What if he hasn't changed? But maybe I'm also looking for closure or clarity.
Closure or clarity sounds like a wise pursuit. Approaching this with honesty about your feelings could help, whether it's rekindling or moving on.
You're right. I need to face this rather than let it linger. I’ll try talking to him openly and see where it leads, focusing on what's best for me.
That sounds like a healthy step forward. Remember, whatever you decide, it should align with your needs and well-being. I'm here for you, whatever happens.
Thanks, I really appreciate your support. It's good to know I'm not facing this alone.
I'm always here. Take it one day at a time, and trust in your ability to navigate these feelings. You've got this, Amanda.
Thank you, truly. I feel a bit more grounded talking to you, and that's what I needed right now.

current_prefix.text: Hey Andrew, how have you been doing lately?
Not too great, to be honest. Things have been a little rough with my friends.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about it?
Yeah, I confronted them about how they haven’t been inviting me to things, and it didn’t go as I hoped.
That must have been really hard for you. What happened when you talked to them?
Well, some of them seemed surprised and apologetic, but others kind of brushed it off or got defensive.
It's understandable that you're feeling upset about that. How did their reactions make you feel?
I feel really hurt by the ones who brushed it off. I thought we were closer than that.

turns.text: Hello there! How can I encourage you today?
Hi, I have been going through a lot of stress with school and am also sad and lonely as of late and not sure how to make myself feel better
So you have had a lot of stress with school lately and are struggling to keep yourself cheerful?
Is there something in particular at school that is stressing you out? Exams? Relationships?
Yes! Its very hard to keep positive with all the work I have and I feel I am not doing well.
Yes, I have a lot of exams right now and that on top of not hanging out with friends a lot lately has made life tough.
I can understand being stressed if you think you are not doing well in school and have a lot of work. How are your grades now?
I still have decent grades but I feel like I am not prepared for big exams currently and they are worth a lot

Yes, that can be tough. When I had a lot of tests coming up and a lot to study for, I wrote down goals to study -- like I broke down the classes and made certain goals to study a bit in each class. And then if I did that, I could go out with friends or some reward like that.

For example, if you have 7 classes, you can make a chart for when you will study for each of those classes and then check them off as you accomplish it, maybe not all in one day, maybe break it up in reasonable bits. Then study according to your goal, if that makes sense.
I remember after each class, I would take 15 minutes to review all my notes from class, that seems short, but really, it adds up and helped so much.

Yes, I think you have excellent advice about organization. I feel like I lose track of what I have and when to do it. I also bounce between classes, feeling stressed because there is so much. Do you think doing one class at a time is best?
I also tend to save stuff sometimes so I have a lot of work build up with tests on the same days. I am not sure how to stop procrastinating.
Yes, stick to one subject at a time. For example, if you think 1/2 hour is good enough to study, then stick to that. When done, your done until the next time it is on your schedule.
Ok. Thank you so much for the ideas. It seems like you have had similar experiences with stress from school.

Procrastination never makes us feel good. If I keep putting something off, I then feel guilty. If I make a goal, and I reach it, I can put a reward. For example, if you study 3 subjects 1/2 hour each, you can go out for yogurt with a friend. So you reward yourself for sticking to that goal.

Yes, I did. lol I'm really old now. This technique I use in all my life. Even house chores, I break it down into a schedule, put it in writing, then check off what I do. Then I feel good about my accomplishments.
Yes, that was my other question to you. It sounds great to just do a little time for each class but I often get overwhelmed and need a break
I have never used check lists or planners. I think it is part of how I get overwhelmed maybe.
Definitely you need a break, so schedule them as rewards. You can even do 15 minutes in say 4 subjects, then take a walk, take a cup of tea, or call a friend, then back to the books.

Keep it as SIMPLE as possible, don't get bogged down. I used to think planning was TERRIBLE< but actually, it sets one FREE. You feel so much better and accomplished when you see how much you have done. It really is amazing.
HOw man classes do you have?
many *
I have 6 classes

That's a lot but it is totally doable. Here is a good example, If you plant seeds in a garden today, you have to weed it a bit tomorrow, the next day, the next day, you have to wait for rain, then weed some more, the harvest comes and YAY! You are happy. But if you lie on your bed, never planting, never weeding, you procrastinate, you get nothing.

If you write your classes down and then write a reasonable time to study each one. Maybe 3 today, 3 tomorrow, then add rewards if you do that, maybe make a list of rewards, so you can pick and choose, then you check off when you do the subject.  Like a chore chart.
Yes haha. That is a good comparison. You have been super helpful. I will for sure try to use your advice. Thank you!
Have a great day and thanks again
You are quite welcome! God bless have a great day!
Hello
How are you doing today?
hello
How can I help you?
I need ways alleviate stress while studying
It sounds like you are having some difficulty at school, I have definitely been there.
yeah, it can be tough sometimes and feel like you're in a dead end situation
Yes I worked a dead end job for ages when I was younger and sometimes you just feel stuck
How did you push past that job?
I am going to be honest a little luck was involved I managed to impress a customer that came in and ended up applying at their work.
Are you still with that job now, enough to consider it a career?
I would say so I am an insurance broker, it has only been a year or so but there seems to be room to move up. You can find something too
Is there any advice for getting out of my situation?
aside from luck that is
Can you give me some more details?
I just find the work mundane and way too remedial
That is completely understandable
did you look at any websites or other job searching tools before you found your new job?
I have you a few, there are also many ways to gain skills online that buff up your resume a bit
what types of skill can I gain online?

Indeed is one of the better ones to look for jobs, honestly I would suggest looking at jobs that you normally wouldn't and see what kind of qualifications they need and see if you can get that done online.
so filter based on my absolute needs and go for online skills that I can complete?
yes I think that is a great idea, look for jobs that meet your needs and figure out what you can do to look attractive to employers
I have tried glassdoor before, have you had any luck there?
I used it a bit, I mainly used indeed.
and have you showcased your skills using LinkedIn before? I have had that one recommended to me before, they said its a great way to neatly organize accomplishments and personal background
Yes especially if you are applying for anything in a professional setting that is very important.
do you have any examples of online skills you completed?
coursera has a lot of great courses, it really depends on what you are looking for.
if I was looking to enter the engineering field, any recommendations?
Is that what you are going to school for?
yes but I may change my mind
What year are you in? most engineering programs have a practicum and that is a great opportunity to make contacts and potentially get offered a job
yes I have been networking as I go
Honestly you seem like you are pretty on top of this I don't think you will have any issues finding a job.
yeah I mean the topic was about final exam stress but we got on a tangent
Yes that is fair enough, how much time do you have until your exam?
15 minutes
While that is plenty of time to get some studying done:)
yes I probably should, thank you for your insight!
Honestly I find that if you are going for the test right away I always like to just breath and relax a bit.
yeah no use in cramming for more info when I could just chill out
You seem like you know what you are doing, I think you will do just fine
yup thanks
Hi
I am really very angry with my friends for not inviting me
Why is that?
I didn't did any anything wrong to my friends but they are simply saying they forget me
So they no need on me ,
I am not important person to them
I have been angry with friends as well, but time loves a hero, as they say.
In my all events i am inviting them all but how they
Why what happen..?
How long have your friends been neglecting you??
In last 2 events only , what about you
Any other questions for me?
I know it is hard at times, but be strong.
You are correct
sometime it will happen , but we should forget and move on
How many best friends do you have ?
How can I help you today?
I'm disgusted with my professors that they don't see me as a human with real emotions and feelings.
I understand that you are feeling like your professors don't see you as a person with feelings. What happened to make you feel this way?
I have testing all the time and study non-stop, but the professors don't seem to encourage or support me.  They just see me as a number I feel.
That's hard to feel like they are treating you like a number when you are working so hard.  Have you talked to them about it?
It's hard to trust them when I'm seen as 1 of 100 people.  If I am struggling they don't flinch or ask me how they can assist.  I just am expected to
tough it out.
I had a similar experience in my college days. It was very difficult to have so much pressure to succeed and feel so alone.  You can do though because you are working hard and want to succeed.
Thanks for the encouragement.  Where do I start to help myself feel better?
I see you are anxious about this when talking to you, but have you thought about getting some support from other students in your position?
That sounds like a good idea.  Maybe they are feeling this way too.
Also sometimes just stepping back and taking some deep breaths can help to alleviate some anxieties. Have you tried that ever?
I will have to give that a try.  I've done that in the past and had forgotten just how much that helped me before.
That is reassuring that it worked before for you and  can work again.

I'm so worried about failing because I just don't feel the support from my professors to care either way for my successes.  It's so different from high school and home when my parents encouraged me and supported me full-heartedly.
College can be quite a change from the protective atmosphere of home.  Have you tried any support groups or religious groups for encouragement?
I am religious so perhaps I could seek a group out and they could help with encouraging me.
I was a  part of a religious group in college and they were very supportive even praying for me on exam days.  I felt they helped me with my success by planting seeds of positive feedback to me.
I used to be part of one during high school years, and that sounds like it would help.
Are you starting to feel better about the situation?
Yes, I do thinking about other people filling in the gaps and supporting me when others won't or can't. Thanks for chatting.  This was helpful.
You are welcome.  I wish you well.
I think I have a few tools now to make things better.

current_prefix.text: Hey Taylor, I've been thinking about you. How are you holding up today?
Hey... It's been a rough day. I found out my close friend was hospitalized, and it just feels like too much right now.
I'm so sorry to hear about your friend. That must be really hard to process. Do you want to talk more about it?
Yeah, it's just...she've always been there for me, especially through the whole thing with my ex and when I was struggling at school. It feels surreal not being able to support her now.
It sounds like they mean a lot to you, and not being able to be there for her must be really tough. It’s understandable to feel overwhelmed.
Exactly. And it's like all these emotions from the past are surfacing again - the argument with my parents, the panic attacks, the trust issues with my professor. Everything seems to be piling up.
It’s okay to have all these emotions. You've been through a lot recently. How are you managing to cope with everything?
Well, I'm trying to stick to some of the things my therapist suggested, like journaling and mindfulness exercises, but sometimes it feels like I’m just going through the motions.
Journaling and mindfulness can be great tools, but it’s also okay to not have it all figured out right now. Are there moments where you feel a bit more at ease?
Maybe when I'm writing, or when I'm engaging with the online writing community. I get what it feels like to be overwhelmed creatively and emotionally.
That's wonderful to hear. It’s important to have spaces where you feel understood and supported. What’s been inspiring your writing lately?
I haven’t been writing as much because of the writer's block, but the supportive messages from the community have been motivating me to start again, even if it's just jotting down ideas.
It sounds like you're slowly finding your way back to your passion, which is amazing. Give yourself time and space; creativity can be a healing process too.
True. I guess I just need to be kinder to myself. It’s just hard when everything feels so uncertain and unstable.

turns.text: Hello. I wanted to talk about my academic pressures.
Hi there. What academic pressures are troubling you today?
Just lots of classes and expectations. Especially with group projects.
Needed someone to talk to about my stress and workload. I don't know what to do with these horrible group members.
I see. It sounds like being in the group project is especially stressing you out. Would you say that's pretty true?
Yes. I have roughly 3 different classes all requiring a group project.
I totally understand. When I was in school I remember being stressed out when we had mandatory group projects as well. Having to deal with others can be a bit stressful at times.
I agree. I also just don't know which project to proritize
I hear you, it sounds like you have a lot going on.
Yep.
What should I do to relax my mind?
Have you thought about seeking advice from a close friend or family member?
Not yet, I am scared to tell my family, considering that they view academic success heavily
With friends, most are busy with their own struggles and I don't want to be bothering them as much
I see, it sounds like you are dealing with your academic pressures all on your own right now then?
Totally. Feels pretty tiring and heavy
Is there possibly a school councilor you could seek advice from?
Maybe, but it feels scary and very awkward to seek them
I hear you, it's definitely not for everyone.
thank you for understanding and talking with me
Of course! We all need an ear to listen once in a while :)
It really helps to get this off my chest
I'm so happy to hear that, it sounds like this was something building up. It's always good to let things out in one way or another.
ya it does help
Is there anything else you would like to talk about today?
Nothing really.
Thanks for the conversation!
Okay, and of course! I'm glad I could help.
hi there! how are you feeling today?
i feel depressed
i'm sorry to hear that. is there a specific reason you are having these feelings?
i feel alone. i feel like i do not have anyone to talk to when it comes to my emotions.

I understand. I have been feeling quite lonely too, I find myself feeling lonely at work and struggling to find someone I trust to talk to about these emotions. Do you have a friend or family member that you trust who might understand some of these feelings?
i do have a few friends that i think i can talk to about how i am feeling however the thought of them being too busy with their work is what prevents me from reaching out to them.

I understand. Correct me if i'm wrong, it sounds like you're nervous to open up to these trusted people because you think they might be distracted by their work to provide the empathy you need and fully understand how you are feeling. Does that sound right?

you know i think that you are right about this. it has always been difficult for me to open to others even with those that have been there for me when i needed someone. i feel like a mix of emotions nervous but at the same time wanting to reaching out for help

I understand these feelings very well. Sometimes, my fear overshadows my want for help. I find it easier to open up to others through writing rather than face to face. Have you considered putting your feelings in writing and opening up to trusted friends and family in this way?

i have been writing for a while but due to my emotions i have stopped writing like i used to. when i did write i did notice a change in my feelings it became more positive and less depressed. now that i stopped writing its like i went back into depression

It sounds like writing your feelings down helped you greatly in the past. May I suggest going back to writing and even letting someone you trust read what you have written down to understand how you are feeling?

yes, writing has been a huge help for me. I would take your suggestion and begin writing again to feel better. and i have let others read what i wrote and they have said it has helped them get over their depression and helped them understand me more
That's great! I am glad to hear that you will begin writing again. Thank you for opening up to me about your feelings. How do you feel about the solution we have come to today?
now that i was able to talk about how i feel with you and you giving me a useful suggestion i feel less depressed and feel motivated to write again. your help has been really helpful for me
That's wonderful! I appreciate your honesty about how you are feeling. I am proud of you for seeking help. Is there anything else you would like to discuss?
thank you so much for helping me. and that is all that i would like to discuss. you have been a big help for me

I am glad I could be here for you! I am hoping you continue to feel better and your writing helps to work out these feelings.  Thank you so much for being open with me. I hope you have a fantastic rest of your day! :)
thank you. hope you enjoy your day
Hi, How are you?
I am the youngest of 5 siblings and I feel all most days now because of my parents
It sounds like you're having a hard time feeling like you have your parents' attention, is that right?
Not their attention, but more on their expectations on me
That sounds frustrating, I'm sorry
Do they do or say anything specific that makes you feel those expectations?
Yes, its more on comparing me to the children of their friends. They always say why don't I have a better job or even plans on marrying rich. Stuff like that is very frustrating
They also expect me to take care of them financially soon, I'm just starting my adult life I want to enjoy it
That sounds very frustrating. I think if I felt those kind of expectations I would be anxious.
Do you feel comfortable talking to them about your feelings?
I do feel anxious every time.
I tried a couple of times, but my mom always sees it as being too sensitive
Sometimes it can feel impossible to talk to parents
I know, is it better if I stay away for awhile? since taking to them won't make sense?

I think that it can be very healthy to get some distance, but I think it can also feel difficult -- do you have good friends in your life that you could lean on if you needed some distance from your parents?
Yes, I do. They actually helped me coped up. I always think that I wasn't blessed with my family, but I'm blessed with good friends
Good friends can be a huge comfort and it sounds like you're a good friends yourself if you have those kinds of friendships
Thinking about it, they really did help a lot. So I should really distance myself for a while right?
I think if making distance helps you feel better, you deserve and have a right to that space
Yes, thank you. I really need to that.
You're welcome
It sounds like you are making healthy and careful emotional decisions
Is there anything else you want to discuss about your parents?
How can I help you
hi. my friend told my ex boyfriend he was an idiot for dumping me. it made me feel uncomfortable since i was in the same room. now he is talking to me again. i think he might want me back
What are your thoughts on the relationship?

my feelings fluctuate. i resent him that he ended it. it confuses me he still wants to be in my life. he said he wanted to be friends but then asked me out again. i think he is trying to work his way back in. i know i can't keep it up unless he makes it clear he wants to be with me. i don't have time for games
That does sound hard that he is giving mixed signals.
yeah i don't like that. neither does my friend. why she told him he is an idiot for letting me go
Do you think he took your friend's comments seriously?
yes cuz that's when he wanted me to be around him more
It sounds like your friend got him thinking.
it seemed like it did
Do you feel his change is genuine?
to a degree. i think he has ulterior motives too.
What would he have to do to prove himself?
say he wants me back or something to that effect. i'd like him to be more direct in what he wants from me
It sounds like it would help if he were direct with you and not sending mixed signals.  Is that correct?
yes that would be nice. he tends to beat around the bush then lets me know
Have you talked to anyone else besides your friend about your concerns?  Do you think your family or other friends could give some additional support to you?
yes i've talked to them about it. they've given me some insight into it. i know they want me to be careful. they don't want me to be hurt
That's understandable that they want you to be careful.  My parents and friends watched out for me too.
we are lucky they look out for us. they can't all be wrong if they're guiding us a certain way
I think you hit the nail on the head that it's helpful to have that support.
absolutely. i appreciate your help! nity nite
Thanks.  Can I assist you with anything else?
nope. im good
Have a good night.
Hey Taylor, it's good to see you here. How are you holding up these days?
Hey. I'm managing, I guess. Just trying to keep up with everything.
I hear you. With school and everything else on your plate, it must be a lot. Anything in particular that's been weighing on you?
Yeah, it's mostly about Nate, my ex. We had a big argument and things have been weird since then.
I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds tough to go through a fallout with someone who used to mean a lot to you.
Yeah, it really sucks. I thought we were on the same page about things, but that argument just brought up a lot of unresolved issues.
Conflicts like that can be really revealing, but also painful. Do you feel comfortable sharing what the argument was about?
Sure. It started off as a small disagreement about our future plans, but it escalated quickly.
It's amazing how sometimes the smallest things become a big deal. Do you think it was more about the future or something else underlying it?
I think it was a bit of both. We've had different ideas about our futures for a while, and maybe we were ignoring it until now.
That makes sense. It's hard to navigate differences when you're emotionally invested. How does that make you feel now?
Honestly, it's exhausting. I keep playing the argument over and over in my head, trying to make sense of it.
I can imagine how tiring that must be. Sometimes our minds just want to find an answer, even when one isn't clear-cut.
Exactly. It's like I'm looking for signs of who was right or wrong, but I end up just feeling more tangled.
Maybe it's not about right or wrong but about understanding where each of you is coming from. What do you hope to achieve by unraveling these feelings?
I'd just like to find some peace with it, I guess. Maybe closure or even a chance to talk about it calmly.
Closure sounds like a healthy goal. Giving yourself time to process everything is important, though. Do you feel like there's space to have that calm conversation with Nate?
Part of me hopes so, but I'm not sure if either of us is ready yet. There's still a lot of raw emotions.
Emotions can take time to settle. It's okay to wait until it feels right. Meanwhile, how are you taking care of yourself?
I've been writing a lot, which helps. It's been a good outlet, even if it's just jotting down how I feel.
Writing can be really therapeutic, I agree. You have a wonderful gift for expressing your emotions through words.
Thank you for saying that. It makes me feel less alone in all of this.
You're definitely not alone, Taylor. I'm always here to listen whenever you need.
I appreciate it. It means a lot to have someone to talk to who gets it.
Anytime. Take your time with everything and remember to be kind to yourself.

Ha, well after two years, feelings had to have changed. Even a little. Does he live nearby?
Yeah someday. I think I will have to try you know. THanks for the advice.
Hello. How are you feeling today?
Hi, I'm feeling really anxious today.
What has made you feel anxious?
Yesterday my company laid off 10% of the workforce and another 10% got furloughed.
I'm afraid I might be in the next round.
I am very sorry to hear that. I am currently in a situation where furloughs are greatly affecting my family as well.
Oh no that's terrible.
The problem is, I am right now the only breadwinner in the family. My wife was laid off three months ago
Are you given specifics on time of furlough?
No, it's basically until things get better.
I know that's very difficult. And no doubt why you're here working for crumbs.
It's why I'm here as well.
Yeah, trying to make ends meet wherever I can
I've been also trying to do uber as well but everyone is doing it also
I know it's a difficult time. Yes Uber is definitely overrun right now. Have you taken any time out to address your anxiety so it doesn't become more serious?
I don't know what I can do. I've been trying to keep busy. And I can't afford a therapist or anything like that.
Yes, that's definitely an expense you can't afford right now. But are you familiar with the concept of controlled breathing to help reduce or relieve anxiety?
Like meditation?
What am I supposed to do? Just breathe in and out a lot?

Not exactly. Controlled breathing is more of getting yourself into a quiet room. Closing your eyes, and purposely and intently focusing on your breathing. Slowly breathe in for a count of 5, then slowly exhale for a count of 5. Repeat this process for approximately 10 minute. It will help your stress levels and help regulate your heart rate!
Oh I didn't know that. No, I haven't tried that. Does it really work?
I've been using it myself over the past 3 months and it most definitely helps! But it's absolutely imperative to clear your mind and have complete quiet.
ok I can try it I guess
thanks for that tip
No problem. I hope this gives you some relief! Stay strong!
yeah, thanks. same to you

My final piece of advice would be to set aside time that is specified where nothing negative is discussed. No politics, no bills, nothing anxiety producing for you. It's probably best if this time is within an hour of your bedtime becuase anxiety is not conducive to a good night's sleep.
That's helpful. Thanks.
No problem. Take care. Wishing you well on your situation.
Thanks. You too
It keeps us up at night because we know she isn't sleeping.  Worse part is there is nothing we can do to help her.
Hi! It seems someone in the family is having sleeping issues. Correct me if I am wrong
My daughter is really sick and its causing her to have trouble sleeping.  Not sure what to do.
Sorry to here about it. It must be hard for you to see her in trouble.
May I ask What happen to her.
It is.  She's miserable, and it's causing us to not sleep as well.
It's nothing serious, common cold, but she has asthma so whenever she gets sick, it causes labored breathing.
I can feel how stressed you are right now but she will recover fast.
I know she will, I always lack sleep whenever she's not feeling well.  I wish I could be sick for her.
When my kid have cold, I nebulize her and later it make her sleep well
We do the same for her, and it helps for a couple hours but then she's up again.
Some people says giving green tea helps in cold.
Really, I'll have to try that. Thank you!
Taking steamed shower helps in cold as well. You can try that too. I will pray for her speedy recovery.
Thank you so much.  You have been very helpful.
I feel much better after talking with you.
I hope you have a good rest of the day.
Mt best wishes are there with you. Be positive she will sleep well and recover soon.
I will. And I pray that she will.
Hey Charles, I'm here for you. How are you holding up after everything with Emily?
Hi, it's been really challenging. Seeing Emily in the hospital is something no parent wants.
I completely understand. It must be really hard to see her go through this. How is she doing now?
She's stable now, thankfully. But every time she has an episode, it takes a toll on us, especially Margaret.
I'm relieved to hear Emily is stable. The stress must be immense for you both. What's been the most difficult part?
I think it's the feeling of helplessness. We do everything we can, but it feels like we're just waiting for the next attack.
That sounds overwhelming, Charles. Feeling helpless is tough. Have you found anything that helps ease that feeling, even a little?
Talking to someone helps a bit. And knowing we're following the doctor’s advice, but the uncertainty lingers.
It's good that you're reaching out and following medical guidance. It's okay to feel uncertain; anyone would in your shoes.
Thanks, I appreciate that. Margaret tries to be strong for Emily, but I can see it's wearing her down too.
Margaret sounds like a wonderful mother, but it's important for both of you to care for yourselves too. How are you supporting each other?
We're trying to talk things out and give each other breaks. It's a work in progress.
That's a healthy approach. It's so important to lean on each other and take things one day at a time.
Yeah, some days are better than others. Getting back to a routine helps, but the worry is constant.
That constant worry must be exhausting. Do you have any outlets or activities to help manage it?
I try to go for a run in the mornings. It's not much, but it clears my head for a bit.
Exercise is great for stress relief. Even small moments of peace are valuable. You're doing your best, and that matters.
Thank you. It's good to hear that. It's just hard not to feel guilty for needing time away.
Taking care of yourself isn't selfish; it's necessary. Being at your best helps you support Emily and Margaret even better.
You're right. I need to remember that. It's a delicate balance, but we're getting there.
It sounds like you and Margaret are doing an incredible job under tough circumstances. Keep leaning on each other. You're not alone.
Thanks for listening. It really helps to talk things out and know someone understands.
Anytime, Charles. I'm here whenever you need to talk. You're doing great, just keep taking those steps forward.

current_prefix.text: Hey there, can we chat for a bit?
Of course, Jane. What's on your mind?
I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately. I'm actually considering switching jobs.
That sounds like a big decision. What's been making you feel this way?
It’s just a combination of things. The pressure at work never seems to end, and after the performance review last November, I’ve been second-guessing myself a lot.

turns.text: Hello! How are you doing today?
Hello, I'm good and yourself
I'm doing well, thank you!
I am really a little upset.
I'm so sorry to hear that. What's going on that's making you feel that way?
Me and my partner had an argument and I got ghosted after. It's been 2 weeks.
That's terrible. So you had an argument and he hasn't spoken to you in two weeks. Is that correct?
Yes
I can imagine that you must be really hurt amongst a number of other feelings. Hearing you tell me that he has done this is upsetting to me as well.
I've had the same thing done to me and I can remember being extremely distraught.
Yeah, I just do not know what to do
Do you mind me asking what the argument was about? If you don't mind going into a little more detail, I may be able to help you more.
I was sick and he did not call me all day to even check in on me. I told him that I was upset about that.

That must be such a terrible feeling. So the argument started because you were sick, he didn't check in on you at all for that entire day, and when you expressed your feelings to him, it turned into an argument?
Has he ever acted this way towards you before? For example, has he ever shown a lack of empathy towards you like this in the past?
Are you still there?
Have you tried reaching out to him throughout the course of these past two weeks to see if he would respond?

I would really like to help you find a solution to this problem, but it appears as though you may not be active anymore. I'm going to wait a few more minute for you to respond before cancelling the chat. In the event that I don't hear back from you, I wish you the best!
Hey! How are you?
Hi, I am having a really hard time. I just found out that my boyfriend cheated on me a year ago.
Have you confronted him about it yet?
Yes, I told him that my best friend confessed it to me. It was my best friend and him. I was so shocked.
Have you broken up yet?

No, I am so mad but I don't want to break up with him. I told my best friends that I never want to see her again though. My boyfriend and I have plans to get engaged this month. I am furious at him though.
I think you should postpone the engagement as infidelity during marriage is far more painful
You are strong if you are able to forgive him though because I know I wouldn't
I have never been so blind sided. Maybe I should reconsider! I have had a guy after me for at least the last year but I never cheated! I really wanted to though.
No you should never cheat, because you would be on the same wavelength as your boyfriend. Instead, if you like the other man then you should go where your feelings take you :)

I am thinking that you are right. I feel like my whole world is upside down and I have wasted all this time with the wrong guy and the wrong best friend. I also wonder who else he might have cheated on my with.
Yeah, that might be true, a relationship isn't healthy if you are cheated on

I am so grossed out because I am a germaphobe to begin with. I have not slept with any other person in my whole life so I feel like I am ruined. I want to throw up when I think of him cheating on me. I want to get married and I have a timeline so I am also really confused on what to do if I dump him.

To dump him is the best thing to do in my opinion. But always go where your heart is, because you won't be happy if you don't. If you do though, there are plenty men out there, and one of them is chasing you
Yeah, the guy who liked me was super rich too! My boyfriend is telling me that he wants my best friend to still be in the wedding party too. She was suppose to be my maid of honor, no less.
Yeah, but don't go with him because of he money though, genuinely get to know him first

I have compartmentalized my life and never thought of looking around at my other options. You are making really good points. I need to just stop and really look at my options. I never realized that I have options, it's not like i am even engaged yet.
Yeah, you have a lot of options at this stage, so always do what your heart is telling you at the end of the day
It feels good sharing how I feel with you because you don't have a dog in the fight so to speak.
yeah, lool something like that ;). Glad your better
I never listen to my heart and think that is a great place to start. I always have a plan and go with that but you are making a lot of sense. Thank you for your time today.
Your welcome ;)
Have a great day and I might be back soon to give an update.
How are you doing today?
I'm not so well.
I see you aren't feeling so well.  What seems to be going on?
I'm really anxious over a breakup.
I'm sorry to hear that you are experiencing a breakup.  That's really hard.
I'm not sure where to go or what to do?
Just from chatting with you, I can see how anxious you are in trying to get a path forward..
I don't know how to be alone.
That's really hard, but there are supports out there.
Where can I go for support?
There are counselors out there to help with relationships.
That sounds like something I could try.
Do you have any family supports?
My sister has been through a similar situation and perhaps could help.
It sounds like your sister could be a great support being that she has had a similar situation.
That is a good idea.
Family can often be a strength for support.
That is so true.  Thanks so much.  I'm going to get some help and am feeling better about things.
Yes, family can be a great support.  I am glad you are starting to move forward with a plan.
Have a great night.  Thanks again.
Thank you for chatting and I wish you well.
I feel so much calmer now after chatting with you.
My friend Lisa borrowed money from me but she won't return it now
I am sorry about that. It is always hard when we trust someone and they let us down. is that waht you are feeling? Disappointment in your friend?
Yes,i am very dissapointed because i trusted her completely.
I understand. I have been through a similar situation.
Was it a large amount of money?
What did you do to come out of the tricky situation?
Yes,it was for me,a total of $10000
Oh, That is a very large amount of money. I can understand your being upset with them
Have you talked to them about the money and returning it?
Yes,i am very very upset.What would you do in my position?
Yes,she just sounded non-comittal,saying that she will return it when she can

I see. It is a financially difficult time for us all. I am wondering if your friend might be upset and embarrassed that they can not pay you back immediately? Have you asked her if she could even afford some sort of small payments?
Yes,i asked her how we could restructure the payment in her favor because i understand how difficult it is for everyone right now but she did not answer
Were you speaking on the phone or in person? Is this a financial burden for you?
Would you consider this person a good friend? Would you be sad if they were not in your life anymore?
We were speaking on phone because i wanted to set up a physical meeting where we could discuss the logistics
Yes,it is a financial burden because this is money i was saving for a venture
That is very difficult. It is hard to judge things on the phone.
Yes,this is a really close friend from way back and i would be devastated to lose the friendship
It is difficult to judge on the phone yes,which is why i wanted a physical meeting but she snapped at me and said that she will just pay me when she can
I see. I am very sorry about that! it is very difficult when a friend betrays your trust like that.
Yes,very difficult
It sounds like you are doing what you can. It is very nice of you to have been this patient.
How do you suggest i shoulp proceed?
Is the friendship more important than the money? That is what it came down to for me.
And you chose what?
If you can not get her to meet with you, perhaps it might be time to seek advice from a lawyer? That is providing that you are willing to possibly lose a friend.
Thank you very much for the advice
you are welcome. Good luck! I hope you find resolution and find a way to save your friendship!
Hey Jane, how have you been holding up lately?
Hi. Not too great, to be honest. It's been a rough couple of weeks.
I'm really sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about what's been going on?
Well, do you remember Lisa? My friend I mentioned before?
Yes, I remember you talking about them. What's up with Lisa?
So, we've hit this weird and stressful snag. I lent her some money months ago and she hasn’t paid me back yet.
That definitely sounds stressful. How is it affecting your relationship with Lisa?
She's completely cut off communication with me. No calls, texts, nothing.
That must be really hard on you, especially since she was such a close friend.
It feels like losing a part of my life. We used to hang out all the time and now it's just silence.
It sounds like you're mourning the loss of that friendship. Have you had a chance to reach out or communicate with her recently?
I’ve tried. Sent a couple of messages, but they’ve gone unanswered.
It must feel really disappointing not to hear back. What do you miss most about your friendship with Lisa?
We used to bounce ideas off each other, and she was the first person I'd call when something great happened at work.
It's understandable to miss those shared moments and support. How are you managing everything else alongside this?
It's made focusing on work tough. I feel a bit isolated, honestly.
I'm so sorry you're feeling this way. Feeling isolated can really weigh on you. Is there anyone else you feel comfortable confiding in?
I haven't really opened up to anyone else about this. It's been hard admitting to myself how deep this issue has affected me.
It takes a lot of courage to open up. It's important to take time for yourself and process everything. Is there anything you can do to help ease your mind a bit right now?
Maybe get back into some hobbies. I used to enjoy painting but haven't done it in a while.
That sounds like a wonderful idea. Engaging in something creative can be really therapeutic. Would you like support picking it back up?
I think that would help. Just getting started again might lift this weight a little.
I'm here to support you with this. Whenever you're ready, you can share your progress, and I’d love to hear how it goes.
Thank you. It feels a bit better knowing someone’s there to listen. I appreciate it.
Anytime, Jane. You’re not alone in this. We'll take it one step at a time.
Hey, do you have a moment? I could use some support right now.
Of course, Jane. What's going on?
I just got hit with an unexpected bill, and it's really stressing me out.
I'm sorry to hear that. Financial stress can be so overwhelming. Do you want to talk more about the bill?
Yeah, it's for my car insurance. I thought I had paid it, but apparently, there was some sort of oversight, and now I owe more than I expected.
That sounds frustrating, especially when you're already stretched thin. How are you handling it so far?
Honestly, not well. I'm feeling pretty anxious about it because money has been tight lately, especially since the whole situation with my friend.
I remember you mentioned that. It must be tough still dealing with those effects. How does that add to your current stress?
It just feels like a never-ending cycle. Losing that friendship was hard, and now this bill feels like another setback.
That's completely understandable. It's like everything piles up at once. How are you coping with these feelings?
I've been trying to budget more strictly and cut unnecessary expenses, but unexpected things keep popping up.
That can make it feel like you're running in place, right? Are there any specific concerns you're dwelling on?
I'm worried I'll fall behind on other payments. I hate feeling this insecure financially. I just want to feel stable again.
It's such a difficult spot to be in. Maybe talking to someone about financial strategies or planning could help?
That's a good idea. I haven't really considered reaching out for advice yet. I'm always thinking I have to handle it alone.
It's okay to ask for help, Jane. You've been doing so much on your own. Sometimes, a fresh perspective makes all the difference.
I appreciate you saying that. I'll look into finding someone who can help with budgeting strategies.
I'm glad to hear that. You're handling this situation with a lot of grace, even if it doesn't feel like it right now.
Thanks. It helps to talk about it. I'm feeling a little more at ease just expressing what's been on my mind.
Anytime, Jane. I'm here for you whenever you need to talk.
I really appreciate it. I'll keep you updated on how things go with the financial advice.
Please do. Remember, you're not alone in this. You have people who care about you.
Hey Jane, how are things going for you today?
Hi, I'm okay, I guess. I got a new journal today to help me figure things out.
That sounds like a positive step. What inspired you to start journaling?
Well, things have been pretty overwhelming lately with everything going on. I thought it might help me process my thoughts and emotions better.
It's great that you're taking proactive steps to manage your stress. Would you like to share more about what's been on your mind?
Sure. I've been really stressed about this money issue with my friend, or former friend now, and the unexpected bills that keep coming up.
That sounds really tough. Financial stress combined with losing a friend can be a lot to handle. How are you managing everything?
It's hard. I feel anxious most of the time. I'm constantly worried about my finances and how to make ends meet, especially with that insurance bill.
I'm sorry to hear that. It sounds like you're carrying a lot on your shoulders. Have you been able to find any moments of peace or relaxation lately?
Not really. I keep trying to focus on work to distract myself, but it's not really working out.
It must be difficult to juggle work with all these thoughts in your mind. Do you feel like journaling might help untangle some of them?
Yeah, I hope so. I haven't written in it yet, but I plan to start tonight. Maybe it will help clarify my feelings and guide me to some solutions.
Starting is often the hardest part, but it sounds like you're on the right track. Taking time for yourself can be really healing. What do you hope to gain from journaling?
I just hope to understand my emotions better and maybe find new perspectives on my situation. I'm also hoping to find some sense of control over things again.
That's a wonderful goal. Gaining insight into your emotions can provide clarity. Remember that you're not alone in this. I'm here to listen whenever you need to talk.
Thank you. It really helps to know that someone is here to listen.
Anytime, Jane. I'm glad you reached out today. Keep me updated on how the journaling goes, okay?
I will. Thanks for the support. It means a lot.
You're welcome. You're doing the best you can, and I'm proud of you for taking steps towards self-care. Take care and talk soon!
I am worried about being perfect on my job.  I don't want to lose my job.
I hear you are trying to be perfect on your job because you are worried about losing your job.  How long have you been at your job?
I have been working for about 4 months, but I just am not as fast at it as everyone else.  I'm trying so hard working late and everything but it's never enough.
That can be hard when you are working so hard to try to do your best.  Can you consult with a supervisor or co-workers to get some help?
Maybe I could ask my friend and co-worker for some tips.  I'm a little embarrassed to do so, but don't know where to turn. I don't want to get fired.
Asking for help isn't always a bad thing.  I asked for help at my last job and they gave me someone to help out.  I was so relieved.
That's true maybe it could turn out for the better.  But what if they see me as incompetant?
I can see that you have worry of being seen incompetent but as long as you are doing your best, they have to see the efforts you are making as positive.
That's a good way to put it.
Sometimes deep breaths can help keep you calm when approaching others in an anxiety provoking situation.
I will have to try that.  That might help.
Have you thought of doing additional work related trainings?  Sometimes they can give suggestions to improve work abilities.
That sounds great.  Do you think my work would be supportive?
Work can often pay for trainings or offer suggestions what may improve work strategies.
Wow, I hope I can take advantage of that.  I will have to check into that.  Who should I approach at work?
You could ask your immediate supervisor or sometimes Human resources for support.
I can do that.  I think I'll reach out tomorrow to Human Resources for some help.
That sounds like a good plan to reach out for support.  Is there anything else I can help with?
No that should be all.  I am feeling more confident in strategies to use to help me.  Thanks
You are very welcome.
Hi, just needed someone to talk to.
Hi Jane! Of course, I'm here for you. What's on your mind?
I had my performance review at work today... and it wasn't great.
I'm sorry to hear that. It sounds like it must be really tough to hear. How are you feeling about it?
I'm feeling anxious and a bit of self-doubt creeping in. I thought I was handling everything okay.
It's completely understandable to feel that way. It seems like there's been a lot on your plate recently. Would you like to talk more about it?
I guess everything's just been snowballing since the thing with Lisa. I still can't believe how it all fell apart.
Losing a friend, especially over something like money, can feel really isolating. How has it been affecting you lately?
It's made focusing on work harder. And getting hit with that unexpected bill last month didn't help. Everything feels out of control.
It sounds like you're dealing with a lot of financial and emotional stress right now. It's a lot for anyone to handle. How have you been coping with it all?
I started writing in a journal. It helps sometimes, but the stress keeps piling up. I thought it would get better by now.
Journaling can be a great outlet. It's important to give yourself grace with everything happening. You're doing your best in a really challenging time.
Thank you. I keep telling myself that, but it's hard to believe it sometimes. I just wish things would turn around.
It makes sense to want things to improve quickly. Progress can be slow, but you're taking steps in the right direction by reaching out and processing everything going on.
Yeah, it helps to talk about it. I suppose I need to take it one day at a time.
Absolutely. It's like building a path through all these challenges— day by day, step by step. You have the strength to navigate this, even if it doesn't feel like it sometimes.
I really appreciate your support. It makes things feel a bit less overwhelming.
I'm glad to be here for you. Remember, you're not alone in this. We can keep talking anytime you need.
Thanks a lot. I might take you up on that.
Anytime, Jane. Take care of yourself, and reach out whenever you need to.
Will do. Take care, too.
Hi Jane, how have you been feeling lately?
Hey, it's been tough, honestly. I've been dealing with a lot of stress and barely sleeping.
I'm so sorry to hear that. Stress and insomnia can really take a toll. What's been weighing on you the most?
It's a mix of things... Financial issues, work, and I guess, the whole fallout with Lisa.
Losing a friend over money is really difficult. Do you want to talk more about what's been going on with work as well?
Yeah, I had a poor performance review last week, and it shook my confidence. It's hard to focus when my mind is elsewhere.
That sounds really challenging, especially when you're already feeling anxious. Have you noticed any patterns or triggers for the stress?
I think it's the feeling of everything piling up at once. Every little thing just feels like too much now.
When it all becomes overwhelming, it's so important to prioritize taking care of yourself. Have you been able to use your journal to help manage the stress?
Yes, I try to write in it every night. It does help to put my thoughts on paper, but sometimes the anxiety is just too strong.
It's good that you're using your journal as a tool. It's natural to still feel overwhelmed, especially given everything you're handling right now.
Thanks. I know you’re right, but sometimes I just feel so alone in this.
You’re definitely not alone, Jane. I'm here for you, and it’s okay to reach out whenever you need someone to listen.
I really appreciate that. It’s comforting to have someone to talk to.
Do you have any plans to tackle the financial stress, or is there someone who could help you navigate that?
I’ve been looking into budgeting more strictly, but it’s tough. I think I just feel angry and sad about how things ended with Lisa.
It's understandable to feel that guilt, but you're doing your best under challenging circumstances. It's important to be gentle with yourself.
Yeah, I know logically I did what I could, but emotionally it’s hard to let go.
Emotions can be tough to navigate, but it’s a process. Small steps are still progress. Have you been able to find moments of peace or relaxation?
I try to meditate a bit or take a walk when I can. It helps, even if just a little.
That's great! Even small moments of peace can accumulate and make a difference over time. You're doing really well to manage through this.
Thank you. It means a lot to hear that, especially when I feel like I'm drowning.
Always happy to remind you. You’re stronger than you realize, and it takes courage to face these challenges.
I hope things will start to turn around soon. I'm trying to keep faith.
Holding onto hope is incredibly powerful. And remember, you’re not alone - I’m here cheering you on every step of the way.
Hi Jane, it's great to hear from you again. How have you been holding up?
Hi, it's been a bit rough lately. My car broke down and the repair costs are just... more than I can handle right now.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that, Jane. That must be incredibly stressful, especially with everything else you've had to deal with recently.
It really is. I've been trying to manage, but the financial stress keeps piling up. I still haven't resolved the money issue with my friend, and now this... It's overwhelming.
I can only imagine how difficult that must be. You've been doing your best under such challenging circumstances. It's okay to feel overwhelmed.
Thank you. Sometimes it feels like I'm just not able to catch a break. I've been trying to keep track of everything with my journal, but it feels like every day brings something new.
Journaling is a great tool, and it's a good step that you're using it to process your thoughts and feelings. It shows how you're trying to find ways to cope.
Yeah, I thought it might help calm my anxieties. But with my job performance not being where it's supposed to be, and money problems, I just feel stuck.
Feeling stuck is definitely tough. It's important to remember that it's not a reflection of your abilities or worth. You're dealing with a lot, and your efforts are meaningful.
Thanks. Sometimes I just worry that I'm not living up to expectations, especially at work. The fear of being seen as incompetent is always there.
I understand. Work pressure can be intense, and when combined with personal challenges, it's a lot to balance. Have you been able to talk to anyone at work about how you're feeling?
Not yet. I'm hesitant because I don't want it to seem like I'm making excuses. I really want to prove myself and get back on track.
That makes sense. It might help to reach out for support when you're ready, even just to get some feedback. Sometimes, opening up can bring understanding and solutions you couldn't see before.
You're right. I'll think about that. Maybe just having a conversation could help put things into perspective.
Absolutely, even small steps can lead to positive changes. Remember, you're doing the best you can, and it's okay to seek help when you need it.
I will try to remember that. It's helpful to talk about it and just get it off my chest a bit.
I'm glad you reached out, Jane. It's important to have a space where you feel heard. If you ever need to talk or get things off your mind, I'm here.
Thank you so much. It really means a lot to have someone who listens and understands.
You're welcome. Remember, one step at a time, and be gentle with yourself. You're not alone in this, and there are brighter days ahead.
I'll keep that in mind. Thanks again for your support.

current_prefix.text: Hey Jimmy, how are you holding up today?
Honestly, not too good. Just got hit with a job performance warning, and it's stressing me out.

turns.text: How may I help you?
Hi I am feeling quite sad today.
Ohh, sorry to hear that. Any partucular reason?
Yes I feel like my friends just don't care about me much at all.
You saying that your friend does not care about you any more. Is that correct?
Yes, when we get together all they want to do is talk about themselves. When I raise something that is bothering me they just ignore what I say and go back to what they want to talk about.
That's not good. You must be feeling left out.
Yes I feel left out and unsupported by them.
Any particular reason they are doing such thing?
Well I think they don't care about me and are just selfish about their needs.
In that case, should you consider them as your friends?
Well they are the only friends I have and I have known them a long time. Do you think I should stop being friends with them ?
If someone is not friendly they are not real friend. You need to find someone who will stand by you no matter what..
Oh well that makes me feel sad too.  I will be saying goodbye to some long friendships. Do you think that is the only answer ?
